policy.crown007_rule: Keep Crown stable as the quality reference, allow opportunistic/shared-fleet improvements, but do not let Crown polish block getting the rest of the roster into production.
policy.porsche: active from owner-authorized project sources; exact model/generation/trim evidence remains mandatory
policy.tesla: active when present in owner-authorized project sources
policy.outside_asset_rule: explicit owner approval required before introducing any source outside the Yardman project source pool
policy.beta1_requirement: use all recoverable Beta1 vehicle/part/material/texture/audio sources
policy.beta2_requirement: for every active vehicle, search Car Parking Multiplayer and Real Racing 3 before promotion
policy.selection: do not stop at first usable source; combine strongest compatible body/interior/wheels/materials/LOD/damage/audio parts across authorized sources without generation relabeling
policy.quantity: no artificial fleet cap; quality and runtime gates apply per distinct vehicle
policy.motorsport: exact motorsport variants may be full player-only vehicles while remaining excluded from AI/ambient traffic when marked player-only

beta2_real_racing_3.recovery_method: dictionary-reset-window random access with per-member size CRC32 and SHA-256 evidence

batch_rule.parallelism: process identities in batches rather than finishing one vehicle before inspecting the rest
batch_rule.primary_goal: bring the wider roster to or above the current Crown007 quality band while preserving close-range fidelity and Android runtime budgets
per_vehicle_steps: collect all compatible Beta1 variants and parts
search Beta2 Car Parking catalog/bundles for exact or compatible identity/components
search the completed RR3 ZIP64 inventory for exact or compatible identity/components
include owner-provided procedural sources when they provide stronger dimensions or original geometry
compare body geometry, interior, wheels, tyres, brakes, glass, lamps, materials, textures, LODs, damage parts and audio
select strongest compatible cross-source component set with provenance
author only the missing production pieces
validate identity and generation/trim compatibility before body promotion
validate LOD0-LOD3 and Android budgets independently without using budget targets to visibly degrade LOD0
defer runtime integration to the main optimization lane

identity_rules.ToyotaMark2: not Toyota Mark X unless exact evidence proves a Mark X source
identity_rules.ToyotaChaserV: not Toyota Mark X unless exact evidence proves a Mark X source
identity_rules.ToyotaCrown: accepted current state; not permanently complete; not primary focus
identity_rules.ToyotaProbox: procedural scaffold establishes dimensions only; final generation/trim and production detail still require source-backed evidence
identity_rules.Porsche GT3 RS family: generation unresolved; no 992 claim without geometry/prefab evidence
identity_rules.Porsche: active from authorized source material; brand permission does not waive exact identity/generation/trim checks
identity_rules.unresolved: must pass identity gate before media promotion
